sentences.text:

 versus
 The State (Govt. Of Nct Of Delhi) & Anr. .....

Respondents
 Through: Mr. Pradeep Gahalot, App for

HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  ORDER % 20.04.2023 CRL.M.A. 10499/2023 1. Exemption is allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application is disposed of.

3. This petition has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in FIR No.84/2023, P.S. Jamia Nagar under Section 376/354-A/506/509/34 IPC on the ground that the petitioner was not named in the FIR which has been filed as counter-blast to FIR No.73/23, P.S. Jamia Nagar under Section 448/506/34 of IPC.
4. The learned APP states that the co-accused in the same FIR has filed an anticipatory bail application and it is listed before the Coordinate Bench of this Court in Bail Application No.1293/23.
It would, therefore, appropriate that this matter is also listed before the Bench of the Hon'ble Justice Anup Jairam Bhambhani, subject to the orders of the Hon'ble the Chief Justice.

5. List before the concerned Bench on 24.04.2023.
6.
Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
